title: Approve the new words and look for the Composer demo
bluf: Look at the pack (composer-new-words-look), then tap. Three merged Composer changes have passed their QA gates and none is on the demo yet. There is one new message a salesperson sees when they try to submit for review with a critical issue still open, five small look fixes on the details screens, and a fix to the exception table on tablets. One word choice is yours: the message says "Validation lists them", which is only true once a validation has been run. The alternative is "Generate lists them on Controls & policy". To change anything, pick b and say what in the note.

options.label: Approve the words and look
options.detail: Friday puts them on the demo under the push-to-demo grant and checks them there. The message keeps "Validation lists them".

options.label: Approve with changes
options.detail: Say which in a note (for example: use "Generate lists them on Controls & policy"). Friday has the change made before anything goes to the demo.

options.label: Hold
options.detail: Nothing goes to the demo. The changes stay merged but not deployed.

default_action: Nothing goes to the demo until you choose.
